query_normalized: estimating causal effects with doubly robust methods on observational data statistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (d) as it provides a foundational methodological contribution to doubly robust estimation for causal effects in observational data (specifically panel/difference-in-differences settings), which is a canonical approach for the user's topic. It directly addresses the mechanism of estimating causal effects using doubly robust methods, even though it focuses on a specific sub-domain (staggered DiD) and adds uniform confidence bands.
